prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the type of marketing you need. To help you find the best fit quickly, tell me a few things (or I can make recommendations if you prefer I search with your answers):

Questions for a tailored recommendation
- What marketing services do you need? (SEO, paid media, social, creative/brand, content, PR, web/app development, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- Industry or niche (e.g., healthcare, tech/SaaS, retail, professional services)?
- Company size and monthly/annual budget range (small business, startup, enterprise)?
- Timeline and key goals (lead gen, brand awareness, retention, product launch)?
- Do you want a local Maryland agency or are remote/national agencies acceptable?

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (example KPIs and ROI).
- Industry experience with similar clients.
- Client references and third‑party reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn).
- Team makeup and who will actually do the work.
- Reporting cadence, KPIs, and tools they use.
- Contract flexibility, pricing model (retainer vs. project vs. performance).
- Cultural fit—communication style and responsiveness.

Where to look
- Clutch.co and UpCity for client reviews and rankings.
- Google Maps / Yelp for local reviews.
- LinkedIn to view team bios and client announcements.
- Local business press (Baltimore Business Journal) for award winners and agency news.

Next steps I can do for you
- If you give me the answers above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs, with a short reason for each and sample questions to ask them.
- Or I can provide a short interview checklist and a template RFP to send to agencies.

Which would you prefer?
